About 293consulting

293consulting helps organisations connect their people practices with their business priorities. We support leaders across people operations, workplace culture, talent development and HR analytics.

We start by understanding how your organisation works, then shape practical recommendations around your goals, resources and team. Our focus is on clear processes, informed decisions and changes your people can put into practice.
